primary_population_policy: active strict_valid_pair rows are the primary/default evidence population for future reporting and baseline candidates
warning_review_policy: separate labelled descriptive/sensitivity/stress use allowed; baseline modelling, strategy ranking, and headline conclusions prohibited until external corroboration and a later modelling gate
stress_event_policy: active stress-event clusters must be preserved and reported; retrospective filters are diagnostic only unless pre-registered or artifact-proven
inconclusive_data_policy: labelled descriptive/adverse diagnostic use only; no baseline modelling, strategy ranking, or headline support
exclusion_burden: burden of proof is on exclusion; warning status, extremeness, holiday timing, or strategy outcome is insufficient
external_corroboration_requirement: target independent BID/ASK source coverage for all warning >=2.0 rows where practicable, minimum full 2024-12-11 cluster plus every other warning >=2.0 date and controls
recommended_next_research_gate: targeted independent BID/ASK corroboration for warning_review active spread clusters before execution-cost modelling decisions
